messages:
Lena (People Ops): @here Quick heads-up — All Hands tomorrow 10:00 PT. Agenda draft below: exec update, product launch callouts, new data-retention policy overview, short incident summary, and Q&A. Please drop questions here or use the intake form: https://tiny.redwood/ah-qa. Recording + captions will be posted afterwards.
Ravi (CTO): +1. I'll cover Dedicated rollout timeline and the latency improvements we've shipped last sprint. Also a brief on the new logging/retention policy so teams know default behavior.
Maya (Product): Will call out launch readiness checklist: docs, SDK compatibility notes, marketplace listing, and support playbook. If your team owns any item, add it here with a checkbox.
Jamal (Eng-SRE): Heads-up: we're doing a small infra deploy 09:30 PT tomorrow for metrics fixes — not expecting visible impact but flagging in case anyone has last-minute release dependencies.
Noah (Eng): Can we have a 2–3 minute customer incident postmortem? There are a few PMs who wanted clarity on mitigation and follow-ups.
Ravi (CTO): Yes — short incident summary + next steps. We'll keep it high level (impact, timeline, mitigations, owner). Deep technical postmortem will be in #postmortems later.
Lena (People Ops): Added a line in the agenda for a 5-min incident summary and a 10-min Q&A. Q&A intake closes tonight 8:00 PM PT so we can prioritize.
Maya (Product): Quick ask — can eng reps confirm SDK PRs that need to land before the external announcement? Drop PR links here.
Noah (Eng): PRs: https://github.com/redwood/api-sdk/pull/412 and https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/118 — both are small docs fixes, should be green by EOD.
Jamal (Eng-SRE): @Ravi do you want a freeze window during All Hands for deploys affecting infra? I can set a short deploy-hold 09:15–11:00 PT.
Ravi (CTO): Yes please — set the freeze for infra-impacting changes. Teams with urgent fixes DM me.
InfraBot: Scheduled maintenance: deploy-2026-04-08-09:30 (metrics hotfix). Impact: low. Notification sent to #eng-oncall.
Lena (People Ops): Reminder: remote-friendly mic check at 9:50 PT for presenters. If you're giving slides, upload them to the shared drive by 8:00 PM tonight.
Maya (Product): Marketing will share the launch brief 12:00 PT today — we need final wording for the feature summary.
Noah (Eng): Can we record timestamps in the recording for the Dedicated rollout section? Makes it easier for teammates to jump in later.
Ravi (CTO): Good idea — we'll note timestamps in the meeting notes and include chapters in the recording.
Lena (People Ops): Action items captured: 1) Eng to confirm PRs (Noah) 2) Freeze window set (Jamal) 3) Marketing brief by noon (Maya) 4) Qs in intake form by 8pm (everyone). I'll post the meeting link + final agenda in #calendar and email.
Maya (Product): One more thing — quick demo of the new model-selection UI. Keeping it <4 mins.
Noah (Eng): :thumbsup:
Ravi (CTO): Thanks all. Recording link will be posted here after the meeting with captions and timestamp chapters.
Lena (People Ops): Last call for Qs — drop them here or in the form. Thanks! :pray:
Maya (Product): FYI, adding three sample Qs to the intake form re: rollout fallback policy and cost controls.
Jamal (Eng-SRE): Noted. I'll be on call during the meeting in case any infra alerts pop up.
Lena (People Ops): Posted final agenda + meeting link: https://tiny.redwood/ah-apr-link. See you tomorrow.
